title: On the Influence of Refactoring Types on Merge Effort
abstract: arXiv:2608.15384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern software development involves parallel work and concurrent changes, requiring code merging. Prior studies report that 10% to 20% of merge attempts result in conflicts, often requiring manual intervention. The literature explores factors that generate conflicts, including refactorings, but does not analyze how individual refactoring types influence the manual effort required to resolve them. We analyzed 64 open-source Java projects and applied association rule mining to measure the strength of associations between specific refactoring types and merge effort. Our results show that refactoring types relate to merge effort with varying strength. In particular, Rename Attribute, Move Class, Extract Variable, Change Return Type, and Split Parameter exhibit some of the strongest associations, especially when a higher number of such refactorings is present in the merge branches. translated_title: 关于重构类型对合并工作量影响的研究
translated_abstract: 现代软件开发涉及并行工作和并发更改，需要代码合并。先前的研究报告称，10%到20%的合并尝试会导致冲突，通常需要手动干预。文献探讨了产生冲突的因素，包括重构，但未分析个别重构类型如何影响解决冲突所需的手动工作量。我们分析了64个开源Java项目，并应用关联规则挖掘来测量特定重构类型与合并工作量之间的关联强度。我们的结果表明，重构类型与合并工作量之间存在不同强度的关联。特别是，重命名属性、移动类、提取变量、更改返回类型和拆分参数表现出最强的关联，尤其是在合并分支中存在更多此类重构时。我们还发现，重构的数量及其类型对合并工作量有显著影响。
tldr: 本研究通过分析64个开源Java项目，发现特定重构类型（如重命名属性、移动类等）与代码合并工作量存在强关联，且重构数量越多，合并难度越大。
en_tdlr: This study, analyzing 64 open-source Java projects, finds that specific refactoring types (e.g., rename attribute, move class) are strongly associated with merge effort, with higher refactoring counts increasing merge difficulty.
